source.label: After-service checklist
source.body: The service team maintains an outage recovery checklist. It assigns an incident lead, a communication owner, and a follow-up review after service returns.

expected.rationale: The source is about responding to and reviewing a service outage.

source.label: Quarterly demand note
source.body: A load forecast estimates the coming quarter's peak requests and compares them with the fleet's remaining headroom. The estimate informs whether another worker pool is needed.

expected.rationale: It forecasts demand against available capacity.

source.label: Record lifecycle
source.body: The retention schedule keeps audit events for thirteen months, then removes them after the legal hold check. The schedule names the owner who verifies deletion.

expected.rationale: It states a period and disposal rule for records.

source.label: Navigation evaluation
source.body: A screen reader announced the form errors only after the participant moved away from the submit button. The team recommends announcing the error beside each invalid field.

expected.rationale: It describes assistive-technology behavior and a usable correction.

source.label: Change window
source.body: The rollout plan sends the new build to one region first, waits for health checks, and then expands in stages. Operators can stop the sequence before the next region.

expected.rationale: It plans staged software release and rollback control.

source.label: Peak-service preparation
source.body: The team combines a load forecast for the holiday peak with an outage recovery drill. Extra capacity is reserved, and an incident lead is named if traffic still overwhelms the service.

expected.rationale: Both demand planning and outage response are substantive.

source.label: Form launch
source.body: Before deployment, the team tests keyboard access to the new application form. The rollout plan blocks expansion if keyboard focus becomes trapped.

expected.rationale: Accessibility testing is an explicit release gate.

source.label: Invoice explanation
source.body: The note explains why a subscription invoice has two tax lines and where customers can download a receipt. It also lists the payment due date and how a credit appears on the next statement.

expected.rationale: Billing explanation is outside this taxonomy.

source.label: Meeting boundary
source.body: This meeting is not about incident response or outage recovery. The only decision is to change the wording of a customer survey invitation and choose a date to send it.

expected.rationale: Explicit negation makes the category term a distractor; the topic is survey copy.

source.label: Expense demonstration
source.body: The presenter clicks the Accessibility tab only to reach an expense export setting. The substantive guidance explains which receipts belong on a reimbursement claim.

expected.rationale: The tab name is procedural navigation, not guidance on accessible use.

source.label: Interrupted change
source.body: A deployment was paused when the service failed health checks. The incident response team restored the previous version, while the release manager revised the rollout plan before resuming.

expected.rationale: It substantively covers outage response and release control.

source.label: Archive policy review
source.body: The archival policy sets a seven-year period for signed agreements and requires a hold check before records are destroyed. The reviewer asks the owner to document each exception.

expected.rationale: An alias expresses record retention and deletion policy.

source.label: Keeping customer records
source.body: Customer messages are kept for one year after an account closes, unless a dispute requires preservation. A scheduled job then deletes eligible messages and records the deletion count.

expected.rationale: The concept is retention despite absent tag names and aliases.

source.label: Hardware sizing
source.body: This is not a deployment or release management proposal. Engineers estimate the next season's request volume and use a load forecast to size the worker fleet.

expected.rationale: The release terms are negated; demand forecasting is substantive.

source.label: Records portal
source.body: The retention schedule requires customer messages to be kept for thirteen months, then deleted after a legal-hold check. The portal must let a screen reader announce each deletion date; reviewers test that announcement before approving the page.

expected.rationale: The source states a retention/deletion rule and an assistive-technology requirement.

source.label: Greenhouse note
source.body: The gardener tests two soil mixes for tomato seedlings and records when the first leaves appear. The note recommends watering the trays in the morning.

expected.rationale: Horticulture is outside the specified taxonomy.
